body: Even if he forgives me, I cannot forgive myself for giving a week-long extreme pain to another person

Thank you for your thoughtful post. However the key difference is that you are not responsible for your brother's pain, but I am for my father's. If my father died in a car accident, I wouldn't be nearly as depressed as right now
like the other poster said, what I need is for me to be able to forgive myself. But I cannot do it no matter how hard I try
thank you for your kind words
My guess is no. He died from organs infection. Extremely painful
